findings.mechanism: The same guide-us act in 38:22 occurs in a demand for true judgment; 16:76 connects commanding justice to the straight path, and 5:8 tests justice against hostility.
findings.reader_payoff: A familiar prayer reaches concrete relations with people, including those toward whom one feels antagonism.
findings.containment: The path remains a broad course; these are specific supplied ethical realizations, not its exhaustive definition. The reciprocal 5:8 warning concerns what 1:6 adds to 5:8, not whether 5:8 can illuminate the focus.

epistemic.reason: The supplied surfaces and branch facets anchor the relation; its application to the petition is a bounded interpretive inference, with source qualifications retained.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey fiziksel, davranışsal veya yargısal olarak düz çizgisini korur, dengeli olur ve sapmaz.
branch_activations.carrier: Rectitude includes judgmental balance and non-deviation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 38:22 asks guide us within a dispute demanding true judgment without excess; 5:8 forbids hatred from bending justice.
branch_activations.activation: A concrete interpersonal judgment can be the act of staying straight.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path petition can include an orientation that remains fair under conflict.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an ethical application, not legal advice or a ruling about a modern dispute.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: düzgünlük, denge ve doğru yoldan sapmama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğru yolda kalma, doğru inanç düzeni ve adil söz, düzgünlük çekirdeğinin davranış ve değer alanına uzanmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The root's extension includes right conduct and just speech.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 16:76 places commanding justice beside being on a straight path, while 38:22 seeks an even path through judgment.
branch_activations.activation: Just speech and conduct give the normative extension independent lexical contact.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness can be heard in what people say and decide for one another.
branch_activations.boundary: The comparison in 16:76 does not authorize reducing human worth to ability or speech.

findings.title: Shared direction without a blanket rejection of plurality
findings.claim: The singular requested path can gather a community in a common direction while the wider evidence also speaks positively of plural divine ways and paths of peace.
findings.mechanism: The warning about dispersal in 6:153 meets positive plural guidance in 29:69 and 5:16; the difference returns through the focus's road and communal us.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish divisive departure from the presence of more than one positively directed way.
findings.containment: The supplied contrasts are preserved together. No doctrine of interchangeable paths or exhaustive lexical taxonomy is inferred.

epistemic.reason: The supplied focus surface and exact wider Arabic state the relation; the return to the petition is explicit.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol, özellikle düz yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, üzerinde ilerlenen yoldur.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite singular road names a shared course to be followed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:153 warns of ways that disperse people from the course; 29:69 promises God's ways and 5:16 calls paths of peace good.
branch_activations.activation: The consequence and orientation of the ways, rather than grammatical plurality alone, distinguishes dispersal from directed variety.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The communal petition can seek coherent direction without declaring every plurality of ways a deviation.
branch_activations.boundary: No fixed technical hierarchy between the route nouns is asserted, and the dispersal warning remains intact.

findings.title: A request open to correction
findings.claim: The request for a right way can expose the gap between received direction and what currently seems right to the speaker.
findings.mechanism: Conjecture and desire in 53:23, self-pleasing appearance in 35:8, and the knowledge boundary in 53:30 and 20:135 return through guidance and the path's rightness.
findings.reader_payoff: The petition can challenge self-confirmation rather than merely endorse an existing preference.
findings.containment: This is a general reading of the act of asking, not a verdict on its speakers. The supplied non-dominant conjecture branch adds no distinct payoff beyond this independently stated opposition and is not used to invent an alternative derivation.

epistemic.reason: The supplied surfaces and branch facets anchor the relation; its application to the petition is a bounded interpretive inference, with source qualifications retained.

branch_activations.activation: Received direction meets a concrete failure of self-appraisal.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The petition can ask for correction of what presently seems attractive or right.
branch_activations.boundary: The contrary examples do not diagnose the petitioner or make all human judgment unreliable.

findings.title: Right direction amid a change of facing
findings.claim: The requested straightness can remain coherent through a change of outward orientation and through conduct that exceeds compass direction.
findings.mechanism: 2:142 places a changed qibla beside straight-path guidance, while 2:177 supplies concrete righteousness beyond eastward or westward facing.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how a direction can be right without being reducible to a fixed line on a map.
findings.containment: The focus neither specifies a qibla nor cancels ritual orientation. The comparison concerns the relation between visible direction and normative rectitude.

epistemic.reason: The supplied surfaces and branch facets anchor the relation; its application to the petition is a bounded interpretive inference, with source qualifications retained.

findings.reader_payoff: Asking for guidance remains meaningful as correction and reorientation during a continuing life.
findings.containment: No lapse is alleged of the focus's speakers and no prescribed ritual frequency is inferred.

findings.mechanism: 30:43 places upright orientation before a day of division; 17:97 explicitly joins guidance and misguidance to resurrection-day gathering; 37:23 supplies a road whose endpoint is destructive.
findings.reader_payoff: The road's stakes reach beyond present orientation to an eventual outcome.
findings.containment: The resurrection branch has a supplied wider carrier. It is not a hidden lexical definition of the focus adjective, and no unsupplied bridge or detailed judgment scene is introduced.

epistemic.reason: The supplied surfaces and branch facets anchor the relation; its application to the petition is a bounded interpretive inference, with source qualifications retained.
